chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
"When you finish the salat (prayer), then turn to your right as you depart."

key_terms.أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Abu Ja‘far, Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended way to turn after finishing salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches an etiquette related to completing salat (prayer): one should turn to the right when departing from it. It reflects a transmitted practice from Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام concerning the proper manner of concluding worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1090 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"When you finish your prayer, turn to your right as you leave."
